title: Repo Rate Dynamics: The Role of Dealers, Hedge Funds, and Issuance
title_zh: 回购利率动态：交易商、对冲基金与发行量的作用
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyses U.S. secured repo spreads by jointly looking into reserves, dealer balance-sheet usage, hedge fund leverage, and Treasury issuance. Using a quantile regression framework, the results show that repo market dynamics are strongly state-dependent. Higher level of reserves consistently compress repo spreads to the Federal Reserve’s overninght reverse repo offering rate and remain the primary stabilizing force, particularly in tighter funding conditions. Hedge fund activity appears to amplify dealer balance-sheet pressures in lower quantiles, reflecting the impact of leveraged demand in normal markets. As spreads rise, this effect weakens. Instead, heavier Treasury issuance appears to weigh on repo spreads via its stronger effect on dealer balance sheet pressures. Overall, U.S. repo spreads are affected by the supply of central bank liquidity, demand for leverage, Treasury issuance and intermediary capacity. Crucially, these drivers are not equally relevant across the distribution of funding conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过联合考察准备金、交易商资产负债表使用情况、对冲基金杠杆率及国债发行，分析了美国有担保回购利差。基于分位数回归框架的研究结果表明，回购市场动态具有显著的状态依赖性。较高的准备金水平持续压缩回购利差至美联储隔夜逆回购利率，并始终是主要的稳定力量，尤其在融资条件趋紧时更为显著。对冲基金活动在较低分位数上会放大交易商资产负债表压力，反映出正常市场中杠杆需求的影响。随着利差上升，这一效应逐渐减弱。相反，国债发行增加通过加剧交易商资产负债表压力，对回购利差产生更大影响。总体而言，美国回购利差受到央行流动性供给、杠杆需求、国债发行及中介能力的共同影响。关键在于，这些驱动因素在融资条件分布的不同区间内并非同等重要。

title: What Oral Traditions Are About and What They Say
title_zh: 口头传统的内容与表达
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Cross-cultural databases are bounded by expert coding and missing observations. The Ethnographic Atlas (EA) codes 1,265 societies on 104 variables, with about 960 societies observed per variable on average, and the Standard Cross-Cultural Sample (SCCS) codes 186 societies on 1,717 variables, with about 105 observed per variable. I use a large language model and the 2,564-motif Berezkin catalogue to extract coverage, what motifs discuss, and stance, what positions they take. Stance, what a motif says, is strongest. Across 26 researcher-designed dimensions, stance is multidimensional (leading component 15.1%, matching ethnographic data) and largely independent of the coverage complexity gradient. On the two dimensions with direct human benchmarks, stance agrees on whether challenged characters succeed (kappa = 0.64) and whether antisocial behavior succeeds or is punished (kappa = 0.49), near the strongest available human benchmark of kappa about 0.57. Among 20 dimensions with no database equivalent, 18 have reliable group-level stance ratios across three runs (ICC >= 0.5$). Nine stance-outcome links survive continent fixed effects, false-discovery correction, and a complexity control, led by outsiders contact for lower GDP and emotional expression for higher female labor participation. Coverage succeeds differently. Across 1,805 usable codebook concepts, coverage predicts 65 of 88 EA variables and detects signal in 35 of 46 pooled SCCS domains, but this information concentrates in one factor. The first principal component explains 43% of score variance versus 15% in EA data, and the resulting complexity index predicts GDP within continents (R^2 = 0.55). Folklore measurement is one-dimensional only when the question is coverage. Researcher-defined concepts become measurable across 958 societies for $0.03 to $1.70.
abstract_zh: 跨文化数据库受限于专家编码与观测缺失。《民族志图谱》（EA）对1265个社会的104个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约960个观测值；《标准跨文化样本》（SCCS）对186个社会的1717个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约105个观测值。我利用大语言模型与包含2564个母题的别列兹金目录，提取了覆盖范围（即母题讨论的内容）与立场（即母题所持的立场）。其中，立场（即母题表述的内容）最为显著。在26个研究者设计的维度中，立场呈现多维性（主成分解释方差15.1%，与民族志数据匹配），且基本独立于覆盖范围的复杂度梯度。在具有直接人类基准的两个维度上，立场在受挑战角色是否成功（kappa=0.64）以及反社会行为是否成功或受惩罚（kappa=0.49）上达成一致，接近现有最强人类基准（kappa约0.57）。在20个无数据库对应维度的维度中，18个维度在三次运行中具有可靠的群体层面立场比率（ICC≥0.5）。九个立场-结果关联在控制大陆固定效应、错误发现率校正及复杂度控制后依然显著，其中外部接触与较低GDP、情感表达与较高女性劳动参与率关联最强。覆盖范围则以不同方式发挥作用。在1805个可用编码手册概念中，覆盖范围预测了88个EA变量中的65个，并在46个合并SCCS领域中的35个中检测到信号，但这一信息集中于单一因子。第一主成分解释43%的得分方差（EA数据中为15%），由此产生的复杂度指数可预测大陆内部的GDP（R²=0.55）。只有当问题聚焦于覆盖范围时，民俗测量才呈现单维性。研究者定义的概念可在958个社会中以0.03至1.70美元的成本实现可测量性。

title_zh: 学生时间的财政不承认：衡量美国公立K-12教育中的强制性学生学时
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model
abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后共置之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年度消费，AI需求仍会降低可靠性、推高电价并增加排放。配备储能的共置模式直接解决了这一时间错配，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，促使最大规模的可再生能源进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接AI活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。AI需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发价格（在受影响的PJM区域高达25%）和停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响规模随模型尺寸扩大。配备现场发电的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致。

title: The many prices of war and occupation: Black markets and the cost‐of‐living index in France, 1938–1949
title_zh: 战争与占领的多重代价：法国黑市与生活成本指数（1938–1949）
abstract: Abstract When studying French prices between 1938 and 1949, economists and historians face a paradox: whilst a vast black market shaped daily life, official indices recorded only state‐controlled prices. This article addresses the issue by introducing a new consumer price index that incorporates both official and black market prices. Drawing on extensive new data, it quantifies black market activity and estimates household reliance on it. As a result, the price dynamics have been considerably under‐evaluated between 1940 and 1944, and equally considerably over‐evaluated between 1944 and 1948. The index reshapes our understanding of price dynamics by challenging the common narrative that the Vichy regime successfully tamed wartime inflation whilst the postwar democratic regime failed to control it. Instead, the apparent postwar acceleration of inflation is revealed as a statistical illusion. Consequently, we show that real wages dropped dramatically during the German Occupation of France, which proves much more consistent with contemporary testimonies.

title: The Equilibrium Effects of Eviction Policies
title_zh: 驱逐政策的均衡效应
abstract: ABSTRACT I propose a dynamic equilibrium model of rental markets that endogenously gives rise to defaults on rents and evictions. In the model, eviction protections make it harder to evict delinquent renters, but higher default costs to landlords increase equilibrium rents. I quantify the model using micro data on evictions, rents, and homelessness. I find that stronger eviction protections exacerbate housing insecurity and lower welfare. The key empirical driver of this result is the persistent nature of risk underlying rent delinquencies. Rental assistance reduces housing insecurity and improves welfare because it lowers the likelihood that renters default ex ante.
